blocks.text:
INSERT
INTO TEAM (TEAM_ID, REGION_NAME, TEAM_NAME, ORIG_YYYY, STADIUM_ID)
SELECT REPLACE(TEAM_ID, 'K', 'A') AS TEAM_ID
, REGION_NAME, REGION NAME |} ' SAE} AS TEAM_NAME
, 2819 AS ORIG_YYYY, STADIUM_ID
FROM TEAM
WHERE REGION_NAME IN ('성남', 'QIA');

INSERT
INTO PLAYER (PLAYER_ID, PLAYER NAME, TEAM_ID, POSITION)
SELECT ‘A’ |} SUBSTR(PLAYER_ID, 2) AS PLAYER ID, PLAYER NAME
, REPLACE(TEAM_ID, ‘K', 'A') AS TEAM_ID, POSITION
FROM PLAYER
WHERE TEAM_ID IN ('Ke4’, 'Kes');
